raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  name: colored
  version: "2.3.2"

package:
  name: ${{ name|lower }}
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/${{ name[0] }}/${{ name }}/${{ name }}-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: d6b7f0737a732c54c92b271f2932c91e386238c8b6ded49d4180eed44eb50684

build:
  number: 1
  noarch: python
  script: ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv

requirements:
  host:
    - pip
    - flit
    - python ${{ python_min }}.*
    - setuptools
  run:
    - python >=${{ python_min }}

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - colored
      pip_check: false
      python_version: ${{ python_min }}
about:
  license: MIT
  license_file: LICENSE.txt
  summary: Simple library for color and formatting to terminal
  homepage: https://gitlab.com/dslackw/colored

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - ozcan
    - jan-janssen
